stylePrompt: Use the declared styleFamily for each item and choose subjects from people, communities, animals, plants, landscapes, weather, tools, vehicles, buildings and everyday objects according to the scene. Keep one coherent style inside each image while varying styles across the batch. Shared constraints: mature learner-facing art direction, landscape 3:2 composition, a clear focal action or relationship, no in-image teaching text, and no live-action or realistic-human impression. When people appear, every readable foreground or midground face must have clearly rendered natural eyes, a nose, a mouth and a scene-appropriate expression. Never use blank oval faces, featureless masks, mannequin heads or shadows that erase the facial features. Vary age, skin tone, facial structure, body type, hairstyle, clothing, ability and occupation naturally. No realistic skin pores, photographic faces, stock-photo staging, logos, watermarks, readable interfaces, chibi proportions or glossy toy rendering.

items.sentenceEn: The matching fingerprints prove who touched the clay.
items.sentenceZh: 相符的指纹证明了是谁碰过这块黏土。
items.scene: An investigator compares one crisp fingerprint pressed into soft clay with the identical ridge pattern on an adult craftsperson's ink-free fingertip impression under a magnifier. The two matching patterns align visually and establish conclusive proof without charts, labels or text.
items.altText: 调查人员比对黏土指纹与手指纹路，两者完全相符。

items.sentenceEn: They hang the lantern from a strong tree branch.
items.sentenceZh: 他们把灯笼挂在一根结实的树枝上。
items.scene: Two adults work together in a garden, lifting one lantern by its loop and securing it to a sturdy horizontal tree branch. The lantern is visibly suspended below the branch with open air beneath it.
items.altText: 两名成人把一盏灯笼悬挂在结实的树枝下。

items.sentenceEn: The storm left the entire neighborhood without power.
items.sentenceZh: 暴风雨使整个街区都停电了。
items.scene: A wide elevated view shows one clearly bounded residential neighborhood after a storm, with every house, streetlamp and shop window completely dark from edge to edge. A neighboring district beyond a river still glows, emphasizing that the whole defined neighborhood is affected.
items.altText: 暴风雨后，河边界内的整个住宅街区全部陷入黑暗。

items.sentenceEn: A bright mineral vein runs through the dark rock.
items.sentenceZh: 一道明亮的矿脉穿过深色岩石。
items.scene: A geologist holds a freshly split dark rock whose rough interior is crossed by one vivid pale crystal vein. Nearby natural stones remain intact, making the solid rock texture and contrasting mineral structure unmistakable.
items.altText: 地质学家举着劈开的深色岩石，内部有一道明亮矿脉。

items.sentenceEn: I sometimes forget my umbrella at the cafe.
items.sentenceZh: 我有时会把雨伞忘在咖啡馆。
items.scene: An adult customer outside a cafe in sudden rain pats an empty hand and looks back with realization, while their closed umbrella remains clearly visible beside the chair they just left inside the window. The separation shows the forgotten object.
items.altText: 顾客走出咖啡馆遇雨后回头，雨伞仍留在窗内座位旁。

items.sentenceEn: The traveler uses a matching tag to claim her suitcase.
items.sentenceZh: 旅客用相符的行李牌领取自己的行李箱。
items.scene: At an airport baggage counter, an adult traveler presents a small tag with a distinctive text-free geometric pattern that exactly matches the pattern attached to one suitcase among several different bags. An attendant returns the matched suitcase to her.
items.altText: 旅客用图案相符的行李牌领取对应的行李箱。

items.sentenceEn: The manager coordinates the busy restaurant team.
items.sentenceZh: 经理协调繁忙的餐厅团队。
items.scene: A restaurant manager stands at the center of a busy dining room calmly directing a server, chef and host toward their next tasks while checking table readiness. The team's attention and coordinated movement establish her managerial role.
items.altText: 餐厅经理在繁忙用餐时段协调服务员、厨师和接待员。

items.sentenceEn: They enjoy a quiet picnic beside the lake.
items.sentenceZh: 他们享受湖边安静的野餐。
items.scene: Three adult friends relax on a picnic blanket beside a calm lake, sharing simple food, smiling softly and watching sunlight ripple across the water. Their unhurried posture and content expressions communicate genuine enjoyment.
items.altText: 三位朋友在平静湖边放松野餐，神情愉快满足。

items.sentenceEn: An official permit makes the new food cart legal.
items.sentenceZh: 官方许可证使这辆新餐车合法经营。
items.scene: A city inspector hands a food-cart owner an official document bearing a large plain embossed seal with no writing, then removes a temporary barrier so the clean new cart can open to waiting customers. The authorized approval clearly enables lawful operation.
items.altText: 城市检查员向餐车经营者交付带有官方印章的许可证。

items.meaningZh: 宗教性的；虔诚的；宗教上的；严谨的
items.sentenceEn: A quiet religious ceremony begins at dawn.
items.sentenceZh: 一场安静的宗教仪式在黎明开始。
items.scene: At dawn inside a serene hilltop temple courtyard, adults of different ages participate respectfully in a quiet candle-lighting ceremony led by a robed spiritual elder. Sacred architecture, reverent posture and shared ritual communicate a religious ceremony without text.
items.altText: 黎明时，人们在山顶寺院庭院中参加安静庄重的点灯仪式。

items.sentenceEn: The mountain lake feels cold even in summer.
items.sentenceZh: 即使在夏天，这座高山湖泊的水也很冷。
items.scene: On a sunny summer day, an adult hiker dips one hand into a clear alpine lake and immediately recoils with a visible shiver, goosebumps and surprised expression while snow remains on distant peaks. The cold water contrasts with warm sunlight.
items.altText: 夏日阳光下，徒步者触碰高山湖水后因寒冷而缩手发抖。

items.sentenceEn: The two fastest runners meet in the final.
items.sentenceZh: 两名最快的跑者在决赛中相遇。
items.scene: Exactly two elite adult runners sprint shoulder to shoulder on the final straight of a stadium track while all other lanes remain empty and a crowd watches intensely. Their equal prominence and decisive last race communicate the final.
items.altText: 决赛跑道上正好两名顶尖跑者并肩冲刺，其他赛道为空。

items.sentenceEn: The main road carries most traffic through the valley.
items.sentenceZh: 主干道承载着穿过山谷的大部分交通。
items.scene: An aerial view of a valley shows one broad central road carrying many cars and buses between towns, while several narrow side roads carry only one or two vehicles. Scale, position and traffic volume make the main road unmistakable.
items.altText: 山谷中宽阔中央道路车辆最多，周围小路只有少量车辆。

items.meaningZh: 科学；学科；学问；自然科学
items.sentenceEn: Science helps the students understand how plants grow.
items.sentenceZh: 科学帮助学生理解植物如何生长。
items.scene: Adult students compare seedlings grown under different controlled light and water conditions, measuring roots with an unmarked ruler and observing leaves through a magnifier. Repeated plants, careful observation and experimentation communicate science without charts or labels.
items.altText: 学生比较不同光照和水分条件下的幼苗并观察根叶。

items.sentenceEn: The green bicycle stands out among the gray ones.
items.sentenceZh: 那辆绿色自行车在灰色自行车中格外醒目。
items.scene: A bicycle rack contains one vivid leaf-green bicycle centered among several uniformly gray bicycles. Identical framing and neutral surroundings make the green color the only strong distinction.
items.altText: 自行车架上，一辆鲜绿色自行车在多辆灰色自行车中很醒目。

items.meaningZh: 记忆；记忆力；回忆；纪念；存储
items.sentenceEn: A familiar scarf brings back a warm memory of her grandmother.
items.sentenceZh: 一条熟悉的围巾唤起了她对祖母的温暖回忆。
items.scene: An adult woman holds a familiar patterned scarf and smiles softly as a warm translucent vignette behind her shows her younger self receiving the same scarf from her grandmother. Matching scarf pattern and affectionate expressions connect present object to remembered past.
items.altText: 女子拿着熟悉围巾，身后浮现祖母曾把它送给她的温暖回忆。

items.meaningZh: 卡片；纸牌；节目单；明信片；梳棉机
items.sentenceEn: She sends a card with a painted flower.
items.sentenceZh: 她寄出一张画着花朵的卡片。
items.scene: At a writing desk, an adult woman places one folded paper card decorated only with a hand-painted flower into a blank envelope. Art supplies and a postage stamp without markings sit nearby, with no handwriting or readable text.
items.altText: 女子把一张画有花朵的折叠卡片放进空白信封。

items.sentenceEn: The eagle circles above the mountain lake.
items.sentenceZh: 老鹰在高山湖泊上方盘旋。
items.scene: A wide alpine view places one eagle circling high in open sky directly above a blue mountain lake, with a clear vertical separation between bird and water. The eagle's shadow falls on the lake far below.
items.altText: 一只老鹰在高山湖泊正上方的天空中盘旋。

items.meaningZh: 座；座位；位子；席位；所在地
items.sentenceEn: He offers his seat to an older passenger.
items.sentenceZh: 他把自己的座位让给一位年长乘客。
items.scene: Inside a city bus, a younger adult stands beside the seat he has just vacated and gestures kindly for an older passenger with a cane to sit down. The empty seat between them is clearly the offered object.
items.altText: 公交车上，年轻人起身把空出的座位让给拄杖老人。

items.sentenceEn: The microscope reveals a single living cell.
items.sentenceZh: 显微镜显示出一个活细胞。
items.scene: An adult biologist looks into a microscope while a large circular inset shows exactly one translucent living plant cell with a clear membrane, nucleus, cytoplasm and internal structures. No other cells, labels, arrows or text appear.
items.altText: 生物学家通过显微镜观察到一个结构清晰的活细胞。
